# sh-toggle

**Purpose:** Turns a single setting on or off with immediate effect.

Core · 10 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2496-22571) (node `2496:22571`)

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*

## Types

### Value=Off, State=Default

**Purpose:** Off, ready to change.

### Value=Off, State=Hover

**Purpose:** Off, pointer over it.

### Value=Off, State=Pressed

**Purpose:** Off, being pressed.

### Value=Off, State=Disabled

**Purpose:** Off, unavailable.

### Value=Off, State=Focus

**Purpose:** Off, keyboard focus.

### Value=On, State=Default

**Purpose:** On, ready to change.

### Value=On, State=Hover

**Purpose:** On, pointer over it.

### Value=On, State=Pressed

**Purpose:** On, being pressed.

### Value=On, State=Disabled

**Purpose:** On, unavailable.

### Value=On, State=Focus

**Purpose:** On, keyboard focus.
